The Gauss Rifle Burst features the same versatility as the NC1, but with an easily controllable burst fire mode. NC use only.
The controllable Gauss Rifle S was developed as a highly adaptable combat platform, allowing engineers to tinker with their attachment options based on battlefield conditions. NC use only.

The NC's A-Tross was created as the ultimate in heavy-hitting, long-range assault rifles. Featuring a 30-round magazine and an overclocked propulsion coil firing a high-damage projectile, the A-Tross can drop targets at even distant ranges.
The powerful and accurate Reaper DMR was developed to fulfill the needs of soldiers who prefer to provide support from a distance. NC use only.

The Cycler TRV's fast rate of fire makes it extremely effective in close quarters, though that same rate of fire and high recoil limits its effectiveness at long range when firing in full-auto. TR use only.

The SABR-13's two-round burst walks the line between a long-range marksman rifle, and a mid-range assault rifle. For especially distant targets, this weapon can toggle a semi-auto firing mode for increased accuracy. TR use only.
The versatile T1B Cycler is nearly identical to the original, with an added accurate burst fire mode. TR use only.
The T1S Cycler performs well at many ranges, attributing its versatility to the wide range of customization options available to it. TR use only.

The Terran Operations Rifle is a favorite amongst TR who feel at home with an all-around performer. Deadly accurate with fast reload assists for its 40 round magazine, the TORQ-9's versatility and ease of use make it a solid choice in combat.
The H-V45 was created with a focus on close quarters mobility. Its light weight does not slow the shooter as much as most other weapons in its class. VS use only.
The CME's high projectile velocity and good accuracy make it a very effective weapon at medium and long ranges. VS use only.
The first of many adaptations to the Pulsar VS1, this burst-fire variant provides enhanced control at long range without compromising on stopping power. VS use only.

Vanu Esamir labs developed the Equinox VE2 assault rifle as a versatile combat platform with a wide array of attachment options. Its lightweight design also allows for quicker movement while aiming, and better accuracy from the hip. VS use only.
The Corvus VA55 features low recoil and high accuracy over sustained fire, making it a popular choice for long range engagements. VS use only.

The Vanu's shadowy VX Labs launched the Terminus VX-9 shortly after joining the war. Engineered with advanced cooling systems that allow for its high rate of fire, the Terminus allows users to hold their ground at close-to-medium ranges.
Genudine Dynamics' initial venture into carbines produced the GD-7F. Its high rate of fire makes it an effective weapon in close quarter combat situations. NC use only.
The powerful AC-X11 was released shortly before Auraxis' global war yet still remains in common use due to its famed reliability and high stopping power. NC use only.
The AF-20 Rogue is a burst-fire version of the tried and true AF-19 Mercenary that boasts controllable recoil over moderate distances. NC use only.
The NC2 Gauss Compact was designed with adaptability in mind, and is one of the most customizable carbines in the New Conglomerate's arsenal. NC use only.

Genudine Dynamics unveiled the Razor GD-23 in the early 29th century. The Razor quickly became popular due to its high accuracy and controllable recoil, allowing it to outperform other carbines at long distances. NC use only.
The T5 AMC's damage output and controllable recoil was designed around giving Terran Republic soldiers increased effectiveness in medium range encounters. TR use only.
The burst fire variant of the TRAC-5 provides accurate and controllable firepower suitable for any number of situations. TR use only.
Created to further enhance the carbine's versatility, the TRAC-5 S can choose from an extended array of attachment options. TR use only.
Boasting a longer barrel than its compact Light Carbine cousin, the mobile LC3 Jaguar was designed to provide accurate hip fire at longer distances than the Lynx. TR use only.

Based off of the Pulsar assault rifle platform, the compact Pulsar C was developed to support more mobile operations. While not as easy to control, the heavy-hitting Pulsar C is far more devastating at close range. VS use only.
Vanu Esamir's weapon labs created the Solstice Burst to further extend the weapon's range with a controlled burst fire mode. VS use only.
The Prominence's increased customization options allow soldiers to adapt to nearly any scenario. VS use only.
The Serpent VE92's overclocked power core interface allows for an extremely high rate of fire, making it a lethal opponent in close quarters combat. VS use only.

Esamir Munition Corporation's first forray into the weapons market yielded an LMG that remains accurate while sustaining fire. The EM1 boasts fast reloads and high ammo capacity, allowing it to control firing lanes with ease. NC use only.

Genudine Dynamics developed the 22S as a possible replacement for the NC6 SAW. In comparison to the SAW, it features a faster firing rate and reload time, but is limited by a 50-round detachable box magazine. NC use only.
The Gauss SAW S was designed as a more versatile alternative of the iconic Gauss SAW. It boasts faster reloads and more controllability at cost to rate of fire and magazine size. NC use only.
The EM6's incredible adaptability on the field makes it popular among NC soldiers. NC use only.

The LA1 Anchor is tuned for close quarters effectiveness. It features best-in-class rate of fire for its considerable stopping power, and a 50 round box magazine for quick combat reloads. NC use only.

This versatile variant of the CARV can adapt to nearly any situation thanks to a wide range of attachments. Compared to its predecessor, it features more controllable recoil in exchange for slightly slower rate of fire. TR use only.
The MSW-R was designed to meet the needs of mobile Terran Republic shock troopers. Its light weight and fast reload time allows forward soldiers to push forward without stopping. TR use only.
The T16 Rhino was designed as a squad support weapon that remains accurate, even during sustained fire. TR use only.
Designed with distance and accuracy in mind, the TMG-50's manageable recoil allows it to outperform other LMGs at long range. TR use only.
Developed for a mix of close quarters combat and point defense, the T32 Bull features both balanced recoil and high maneuverability. TR use only.

Embedded recoil dampeners along the barrel of the Polaris allow it to remain accurate during sustained fire while aiming. The Polaris also boasts better hipfire accuracy than most LMGs in its class. VS use only.

The Pulsar Light Support Weapon (LSW) is a Pulsar variant with a high capacity battery and heavier barrel. Its reputation as a highly versatile weapon makes it a popular choice for missions where anything can happen. VS use only.

The SVA-88's overclocked discharge coil allows it to fire plasma at a higher velocity than most weapons in its class. When firing at long distances, the user will need to lead targets much less than usual. VS use only.

Vanu Esamir's AdvWep labs designed the heavy-hitting Flare VE6 to pack the most punch per shot. In the hands of an experience marksman, the Flare can wreak havoc on enemy infantry at close to medium ranges. VS use only.
The Ursa features manageable recoil and a high velocity projectile, making it extremely effective at ranges beyond that of other LMGs. VS use only.
The Hitman's high muzzle velocity gives it a significant advantage when leading distant targets.
The T20 Fist utilizes the devastating 11x105 cartridge, the most powerful round used by the TR. Its unrivaled stopping power is kept in check by the time between shots.
The Lightyear VX2's overcharged plasma generator is capable of eliminating distant targets rapidly.
The automatic AF-18 Stalker is deadly in close quarters and medium range combat. NC use only.
The automatic SOAS-20's high rate of fire makes it an excellent choice for mid-range encounters. TR use only.
The fully automatic Artemis VX26 scout rifle is capable of quickly dispatching enemy infantry at close to medium ranges. VS use only.
The versatile standard-issue NC4 Mag-Shot was the first pistol to utilize Gauss technology. This variant features a unique gold plating.
The LA8 Rebel's remarkable stopping power makes it a popular choice among Conglomerate infiltrators. NC use only.
The 2-round burst LA3 Desperado can quickly eliminate targets at close range, and has access to semi-auto firing mode for increased control. NC use only.
The NC08 Mag-Scatter's powerful gauss-propelled shot shells and compact frame make it an excellent close-range sidearm.
The reliable TX1-FB Repeater is the latest iteration of a firearm design stretching back 300 years. Its three round burst fire mode provides considerable stopping power at close range.
A popular sidearm amongst TR soldiers, the high-capacity TX2 Emperor has been in service for over 200 years. TR use only.
The TS2 Inquisitor features two-round burst or semi-auto firemodes, with an extended magazine capable of outlasting the enemy even in the most drawn out firefights. TR use only.
The Terran Republic's Automatic Machine Pistol functions similarly to an SMG thanks to its lightning-fast, fully automatic fire.
The Beamer VS3 is the standard sidearm for the Vanu Sovereignty. Its high rate of fire allows the user to eliminate nearby targets quickly. This variant features a unique gold plating.
Designed as an all-purpose sidearm for VS soldiers, the Manticore SX40 is able to perform well in any situation. VS use only.
The Cerberus is able to fire overcharged rounds that are highly damaging in close range. VS use only.
Reverse-engineered from ancient Vanu tech, the Spiker makes use of a standard 2x burst, as well as an alternate firing mode which charges up an armor piercing blast.
The iconic NC12 Sweeper shotgun features a high capacity magazine as well as considerable stopping power at close range. It excels in urban combat scenarios. NC use only.
The powerful TS4 Haymaker features a large magazine, allowing for sustained fire without needing to reload. TR use only.
The Thanatos VE70's lethality in close quarters makes it a frightening opponent in urban combat scenarios. VS use only.

This hard hitting but slower firing SMG is used as an efficient personal defense weapon with a sleek black finish.  Made by Nanite Systems, the leading Auraxis firearms dealer. All factions can use NS weapons.
The AF-34 Mattock features increased effective range in comparison to the other MAX anti-infantry weapons. NC use only.
Known for its lethality in close quarters, the automatic AF-41 Hacksaw's high rate of fire gives it an advantage for point defense scenarios. NC use only.
Auraxis Firearms' first venture into MAX weaponry was the AF-23 Grinder. It features an extended ammo reserve for sustained fire. NC use only.
The M6 Onslaught was designed as a defensive alternative to the MX1, allowing for a higher rate of fire suitable for holding down important locations. TR use only.
The M2's increased ammo capacity has proven itself as a boon to small or stranded squads. TR use only.
Ironically nicknamed "Mercy," the latest iteration of the accurate Mobile Rotary Cannon can drop enemy infantry at a distance. TR use only.
The Nebula VM20's overclocked power core interface allows for a rapid rate of fire to quickly dispatch enemy infantry in close quarters. VS use only.

A late successor to the Quasar VM1, the Cosmos uses experimental plasma containment technology, resulting in larger rounds. These large plasma rounds cause less cranial trauma, but are significantly easier to strike mobile targets with. VS use only.
The lightweight Blueshift VM5 anti-infantry MAX weapon was designed to provide increased accuracy over the standard-issue VM1. VS use only.

The NC05 Jackhammer's stopping power and sustained fire capabilities make it a frightening weapon in close quarters combat. It features a unique burst fire mode that doubles its rate of fire. NC use only.
The sound of the menacing T7 MCG firing strikes fear into the heart of its enemies. It is capable of sustained fire that can tear apart entire squads. TR use only.

The experimental Lasher X2 fires volatile orbs of plasma that explode on contact with hard surfaces. Field trials have demonstrated its effectiveness at suppressing fire, flushing out enemies and melting infantry. VS use only.
The G30 Vulcan fires armor piercing 30mm rounds capable of damaging heavily armored targets. TR use only.

The NCM2 Falcon is the standard for the NC's anti-vehicle MAX weaponry. It features powerful warheads capable of heavily damaging enemy vehicles and MAXes alike. NC use only.
The Comet VM2 is the standard-issue anti-vehicle MAX weaponry. The explosive plasma orbs it fires are capable of melting through heavy tank armor. VS use only.

The arm-mounted NCM1 Scattercannon functions as an automatic shotgun capable of cutting through enemy squads. NC use only.
The heavy Quasar VM1 was one of the earliest weapons created with discovered Vanu technology. The rapid firing plasma cannon can tear apart enemy foot soldiers with ease. VS use only.

The Vanu Marksman's Scope is the standard for mid-range engagements. It uses a minimalist chevron reticle inside of its Vanu-styled housing.
Within its ornate triangular housing, the V3 Holo uses a red dot sight and 3.4x magnification for mid-range combat scenarios.

Created to better suit carbines and assault rifles for support roles, the OG-4's simple crosshair allows the user to make accurate shots at a distance. It uses 4x magnification perfect for mid-range fights.
The CSZ's 4x magnification make it a favorite amongst designated marksmen in the Vanu Sovereignty. This scope uses a triple chevron reticle.
The TriGon-6 won the Vanu Sovereignty's bid as their standard sniper scope. It features 6x magnification and standard mil-dot sighting.
Nanite Systems' HS/NV scope has no magnification, but provides high contrast outlines to nearby objects and illuminates nearby soldiers.
Designed as a replacement for standard iron sights in close-quarters combat, the Holo-Projected Reticle sight creates an accurate red dot reticle above the top rail.

This standard issue rifle was the genesis for all future experimentation into weapon design for field operatives. It harbors moderate rate of fire, stability, and stopping power, resulting in a versatile combat platform. NSO use only.
The AR-101 was quick to follow its predecessor's design, with modest modifications that include additional stopping power and controllability at cost to rate of fire. NSO use only.
The semi-auto N203 assault rifle retains accuracy through a controlled, three-round burst, while offering stopping power that rivals that of heavier weapons. NSO use only.
The CB-100 was developed with versatility in mind, arming operatives with consistent damage and reliable recoil at close to mid range. NSO use only.

The CB-X75 is an aggressive carbine built for close quarters combat. The X75 retains better hipfire accuracy than most carbines, and the lightweight design allows for better mobility while aiming down sights. NSO use only.
Big brother to the CB-100, the 200 model was designed to emphasize stopping power and accuracy at cost to its rate of fire. NSO use only.
The incredibly popular PMG-100 became standard-issue after operatives lauded its high rate of fire, and the versatility afforded by its large magazine. NSO use only.
The PMG-200 opts for better per-bullet stopping power and snappy reloads, at cost to its magazine size. NSO use only.
The experimental 3XB offers an automatic three-round burst that drastically increases accuracy over distance, while maintaining the expected sting of an SMG. NSO use only.
The XMG-100's large magazine and high rate of fire solidifies its use during close-to-medium range assault scenarios. NSO use only.
Feedback from field operatives resulted in the release of the XMG-155 that houses a larger magazine and slightly more stopping power than its predecessor could afford. NSO use only.
The XMG-200's design was centered around increased effectiveness during open-field combat with as little downtime as possible. NSO use only.
The standard-issue U-100 Lastly is a reliable sidearm with moderate punch, stable recoil, and 12-round magazine. NSO use only.
Code-named "Recall" after a famous field operative, the U-150 offers a large, 20-round magazine with a mid-range damage profile. NSO use only.
The U-200's high-impact rounds are capable of dropping opponents at close range with little notice, though its magazine size suffers in trade. NSO use only.
All heavy combat units are outfitted with a general purpose dumbfire rocket launcher to contest enemy vehicles as needed. NSO use only.
The LAV-LG can lock onto ground vehicles to fire a homing missile, or be dumbfired when the situations calls for it. NSO use only. <font color="#dc9c36">Optional Lockon: Armor</font>

The LAV-LA can lock onto aircraft at moderate distances, allowing it to fire a homing missile. It may also be dumbfired without a lock when needed. NSO use only. <font color="#dc9c36">Optional Lockon: Aircraft</font>

Labeled a "heavy" shotgun, the slow-firing HSG-400 can down close-range infantry targets in a single shot. While magazine size is limited, the weapon still takes advantage of a standard mag-fed reload system. NSO use only.
What the fully-automatic A25 loses in range, it makes up for in rate of fire. NSO use only.
The standard-issue SG-100 has a large magazine size and excellent pellet coverage, making it a staple among operatives in CQB scenarios. NSO use only.
The semi-auto BAR-100 is capable of engagement distances nearing that of a sniper rifle, while retaining the versatility of a lighter weapon. NSO use only.

Originally proposed as an alternative to the standard-issue AR-100, veteran marksmen found the automatic rate of fire and controllable recoil capable of downing distant targets with ease. NSO use only.
The BAR-200 fires larger rounds than its 100 model predecessor, allowing for maximum stopping power at cost to rate of fire. NSO use only.
Each Chimera comes standard with the CT-135, a main cannon with balanced reload, damage, and explosive yield suitable for a variety of combat environments. NSO use only.
With a sabot payload designed to penetrate heavy armor, the Cyclops maintains high projectile velocity at cost to its explosive yield. NSO use only.
The Satyr's dual-barrel design provides high damage potential over a five-round volley. NSO use only.
As a part of the Chimera's initial rollout, it was given an all-rounder 20mm heavy chain gun capable of combating threats of all types. NSO use only.
After a short charge-up, this experimental particle projection weapon fires a dense photon blast that shreds heavy armor on impact. NSO use only.
The Siren fires a barrage of smart rockets that will divert course when enemy aircraft are within range, pursuing their heat signature until impact. NSO use only.
Contrary to the weapon's name, the Raycaster fires photonically propelled tungsten rounds that are effective against all targets. NSO use only.
An anti-aircraft turret based on the Raycaster design. Photonically propelled tungsten projectiles can dispatch light aircraft at any range. NSO use only.
After a short charge-up, the DV-XE fires a 6-round particle projection barrage that can deal heavy damage to aircraft at long distances. NSO use only.
The rapid-fire Lotus gatling gun excels in shredding close-range aircraft before they can attempt to escape. NSO use only.
The Pixie can fire a stream of guided missiles by maintaining a lock on enemy aircraft. This is particularly effective against larger, more heavily armored vehicles. NSO use only.
This charge-based particle cannon fires a devastating wave of energy that boasts effectiveness against light and heavily armored targets alike. NSO use only.

The "Hummingbird" is a modified grenade printer that fires explosive smart-drones effective against enemy aircraft. The visor will lock onto enemy vehicles within range, and throwing a drone will place it on an intercept course with the target. Drones may also be dumbfired without a lock-on.

The Detonator manufactures a long-range artillery shell carrying an explosive anti-vehicle payload that increases in power the further it travels, dealing maximum damage beyond 100 meters. This weapon has an arming distance of 20 meters.

Scrapped prior to release in favor of the Masamune's wire-guidance system and contextual firing modes, the NSX Muramasa can fire up to four accurate, high damage rockets either from the hip or while aiming down the optics.

Unlike its Yumi predecessor, the NSX Kuwa will, after a short windup, release a torrent of accurate, high caliber rounds down range until the trigger is released. This weapon is a hybrid rifle, available to Engineer, Combat Medic, and Heavy Assault classes.
A precursor to the Tengu SMG, the NSX Kappa spits out three heavy pellets per shot, and was the first SMG to integrate a smart choke system that tightens pellet spread while aiming down sights.

During focus group testing, the compact, automatic, NSX Yawara pistol was overlooked at nearly every turn, failing to reach the popularity of the numerous other Nanite Systems pistol designs released throughout the Auraxian War.

description.en: Wearable by all non-Max classes. NC use only

Imbued with an ethereal violet hue, the NS "Primed Amethyst" Shard is not merely a weapon, but a statement. This blade resonates with those who seek to elevate themselves beyond the mundane, cutting through ignorance to carve paths to enlightenment.

The NS "Primed Diamond" Shard is a paragon of strength and resilience. Its flawless edge mirrors the unbreakable will of its wielder, offering clarity in the fog of war and a promise of enduring fortitude.

Forged from deep azure crystal, the NS "Primed Lapis" Shard is a blade for those who seek clarity in chaos. Its edge is as sharp as the truths it represents, cutting through lies and uncertainty with precision.
Radiating with an intense crimson glow, the NS "Primed Ruby" Shard is the embodiment of fiery passion and loyalty. Each cut it makes is a testament to the price of freedom and the courage to pay it.

Nanite Systems' high density rod and reel for the discerning angler. Used on the waters of Auraxis to catch really big fish.

Use Aim to cast your line and Fire to set the hook & reel it in.

The Sept of Anu believes that mankind, "the Adamu", are the direct descendants of the extra-terrestrial god-king Anu, who visited Earth in prehistory along with his divine progeny, the Vanu.

Devout members of this sect, known as "seekers", are charged with cleansing the Sovereignty of iconoclasts who have lost their faith.



Contains Helmets and Armor wearable by all non-Max classes. VS use only.
Customize your ground vehicle by adding a hood ornament. All factions can use this gear.
Show your friends and foes how lucky (or unlucky) they are to have you around with this Leprechaun Horn!

Designed for the Legion of the Crows, an enigmatic mercenary subfaction within the New Conglomerate. While the cutting-edge technology behind this helmet comes from Woodman Advanced Science & Engineering, the Legion insisted on a bespoke design from Excavion Outfitters-blending rugged battlefield utility with the unmistakable style of a warrior who serves no master but the highest bidder.

Wearable by all classes. NC use only.

Designed for those who endure the brunt of battle, this armor melds ASE's top-tier ballistic plating with Excavion's reinforced framework. Rumors suggest some suits have been field-tested against non-traditional weaponry-perhaps in anticipation of threats yet to be faced.

This armor can only be worn by NC Heavy Assault Troopers.

Perfect for Crows who need to strike fast, and, escape even faster. The jetpack is integrated with enhancements on ASE's Lateral Leap Accelerator, with improved aerodynamics incorporated into the aesthethics, and, optimal burst-thrust efficiency. These bespoke models have even been tested with unconventional energy resistance, hinting that the Legion's ambitions extend beyond traditional warfare.

This armor can only be worn by NC Light Assault Troopers.

This armor integrates ASE's modular plating with Excavion's custom utility harness. A few engineers have been spotted modifying their suits with unfamiliar interface ports-suggesting the Crows are tinkering with something outside standard NC hardware.

This armor can only be worn by NC Engineers.

Optimized for stealth and subterfuge, this armor merges ASE's nanoweave protection with Excavion's adaptive camouflage. Some recent models feature traces of unfamiliar circuitry, sparking speculation that the Crows have acquired-and perhaps are repurposing-tech that doesn't belong to the NC.

This armor can only be worn by NC Infiltrators.

Combat medics in the Legion of the Crows don't just save lives; they adapt, experiment, and survive. While this armor is built for durability and mobility, a few units have been seen with unusual interface ports and concealed compartments-suggesting the Crows may be preparing for more than just emergency care.

This armor can only be worn by NC Combat Medics.
